activeloop.name: Activeloop
activeloop.one_liner: Capture every coding agent interaction across your team, train it into reusable skills, and propagate those skills to every agent in your org. On your cloud storage.
activeloop.description:
Capture every coding agent interaction across your team, train it into reusable skills, and propagate those skills to every agent in your org. On your cloud storage.

Hey 👋 Davit here, founder of Activeloop.

Today we are introducing something we believe will reshape how engineering teams work with coding agents.

Hivemind is a continual learning layer for coding agents. It works across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and pi, and it stores all your data on your cloud.



### The Problem: Coding Agents Don't Learn

Every engineering team building with AI agents already knows the issues.

* Your senior engineer's agent debugs a tricky bug Monday. Your junior engineer hits the same bug Tuesday and starts from zero.
* Every session begins with re-explaining your codebase and your conventions.
* Architectural decisions made in code review evaporate the moment the session ends.
* Your team is solving the same problems over and over, paying for the same compute every time.

Coding agents do not communicate with each other out of the box. Hivemind closes the gap. An agent figures something out, every agent inherits it. Your worst run starts from your best.

The tools tackling this treat it as a memory problem. They give each agent a personal notepad. Siloed. Invisible to the rest of the team. And most of them do it by shipping your code and context to their servers.

But memory without learning doesn't make agents better.

We decided to go beyond memory.



### Introducing Hivemind: Continual Learning for Coding Agents

Hivemind runs on a simple chain: capture, codify, optimize, propagate.

1. Trace capture. Every agent interaction
activeloop.industry_sub_vertical: Coding agent interaction capture & continual learning propagation
activeloop.what_they_sell: Hivemind: a continual learning platform that captures coding agent interactions, extracts reusable skills, and propagates learned behaviors across all agents in an organization. Runs on customer cloud storage; integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other coding agents.
activeloop.ai_play: Transforms isolated agent sessions into organizational knowledge by instrumenting agent traces, extracting patterns/skills from successful interactions, and using RL-style optimization to improve agent performance across the team without manual retraining. Solves the 'agents don't learn from each other' problem.

advanced-metal-research.description:
Machine intelligence for American Welding

America does not just need more welders. It needs welding knowledge that can scale.

The American Welding Society projects 320,500 new welding professionals will be needed by 2029, with about 80,000 jobs to be filled annually from 2025 to 2029. More than 157,000 current welding professionals are approaching retirement. Welders are only a small share of the skilled-trades workforce, but welding accounts for an outsized share of projected capability demand. 

The market calls it a labor shortage. AMR sees a learning bottleneck.

We are building American-made robotic welding cells that combine computer vision to provide real-time seam tracking and post-weld inspection to turn welding from a scarce manual process into a closed-loop manufacturing system that learns from every weld as it happens.

aerogen-systems.name: Aerogen Systems

aerogen-systems.description:
Building the future of advanced chip manufacturing.

We are building the future of chip manufacturing.

Chips are more advanced than ever, and the features inside them keep getting smaller. But the cleanroom infrastructure supporting their manufacture has not scaled at the same pace. Intel, TSMC, Samsung, and others spend billions building and operating massive cleanrooms, only to isolate their most advanced wafers from the surrounding facility as much as possible.

We think that architecture is backwards. Instead of making the entire building cleaner, why not make the machinery itself as clean as possible?

Talos is our proprietary tool-integrated purification system. It sits directly inside semiconductor equipment and continuously destroys airborne molecular contaminants before they reach the wafer. Instead of fighting contamination by constantly flooding tools with ultra-high-purity nitrogen, Talos keeps the environment inside the machine 10–100x cleaner, without the massive purge-gas bill.

Talos is powerful on its own, but it is also the foundation for a much bigger vision: the Cleanpipe.

The Aerogen Systems Cleanpipe is an ultra-clean interconnect infrastructure that protects wafers as they move from machine to machine across the fab. Rather than relying on a billion-dollar cleanroom to protect every cubic foot of factory space, Cleanpipe creates a controlled environment only where cleanliness actually matters: around the wafer.

Behind the scenes, Alter manages credentials, issuing ephemeral, scope-narrowed access for every interaction, then rotating or expiring it in seconds. The result: no long-lived secrets, no blind spots, and no surprises in audit.

With Alter, teams can move fast on AI agent initiatives while staying fully compliant with SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and internal security standards. A CISO-ready dashboard delivers real-time visibility, detailed audit logs, and compliance-ready controls, removing silos, eliminating excessive permissions, and providing complete oversight of every agent workflow.

alter.ai_play: Agents need to call external tools and APIs (databases, payment systems, infrastructure) but cannot be trusted with long-lived credentials or broad permissions. Alter sits in the agent execution path, intercepting every tool call to enforce least-privilege access, verify parameters against policies, and rotate credentials in seconds. Angel Onuoha (CEO) and Ahmad Shehu (CTO) have worked together for 4 years. Before Avelis Health they built Zuvy, a Lagos-based fintech company that provided invoice factoring to small businesses. Zuvy was acquired by The BAS Group in 2025.

Mitch recently got his PhD at Carnegie Mellon working with NASA on kilometer-scale deployable structures, and Pele spent seven years at SpaceX leading Dragon parachute engineering, safely returning astronauts from space.

The collective satellites today use around 20MW, roughly the output of a datacenter on earth, but by 2030 there is a demand for over 10GW, a 500x increase, largely driven by orbital datacenters, space stations, and lunar outposts.

If you want more power, your only option is to launch larger solar panels, which quickly become fragile or impractically expensive. As a result, power constraints already determine whether missions or industries can exist at all.

But at Beyond Reach Labs we have introduced a new class of deployable solar panels giving satellites 10x more usable power without increasing launch mass or volume. This works because our patented deployable design changes geometry in space, allowing for us to reach 10x longer while remaining rigid.

Bizmark solves this by connecting to the systems, inboxes, spreadsheets, documents, and the knowledge that lives in people’s heads, then turning that context into optimized decisions and automated workflows. Bizmark adapts to how each company operates, not the other way around. And customers get a working product in weeks, not years.

Some of the most innovative American companies use Bizmark to transform their operations.

We do this by training RNA foundation models that learn the patterns that shape disease progression and patient response to treatment. We aim to help pharma make more informed decisions in clinical trials by capturing the biology that makes each patient’s tumour unique. 

We’re a technical team of AI scientists and engineers from companies including Recursion, Deep Genomics, DeepMind, and Amazon, and institutions including Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Centre, Stanford, and the Vector Institute.

blaxel.name: Blaxel
blaxel.description:
The perpetual sandbox platform

Blaxel is the perpetual sandbox platform for AI agents that need to run code fast.

Unlike traditional sandboxes that expire or suffer from cold starts, our sandboxes automatically scale to zero after 1s of inactivity and resume in under 25ms with full memory state preserved — allowing you to keep millions of secure sandboxes on standby indefinitely.

We also co-locate your agent logic alongside these sandboxes to eliminate network overhead, delivering near-instant latency for end users.
blaxel.what_they_sell: A perpetual sandbox platform optimized for AI agents: stateful, low-latency execution environments that scale to zero after 1s inactivity and resume in <25ms with memory preserved. Eliminates cold starts and network overhead by co-locating agent logic with compute.
blaxel.ai_play: Removes execution friction for agentic AI workflows. Agents need fast, reliable code execution with minimal latency and cost overhead. Blaxel's persistent-yet-efficient sandbox model lets agents run millions of concurrent tasks at software-like economics, enabling real-time agent interactions and reducing per-execution cost.

Install it with npx @blaze-money/cli. Use it with your favorite agentic harness or at blaze.money/agentic-finance. ChatGPT, Claude apps, and OpenClaw plugin coming soon.

Our launch video: 

## ❌ The problem

You're a lean team busy doing more than you can handle already, and finances feel like a perpetual weight on your shoulders. You know there are bills to pay, invoices to collect on, questions you want answered. But a real finance team costs $10,000 to $20,000 a month, and you could always "do it yourself," so the problem goes on dangling, half solved, half annoyance, always taking up RAM.

What ends up happening is bills get paid late, you spend money on some $300/month marketing software your interns bought months ago without you knowing, and real problems with your vendors, payroll, and runway sneak up on you at 2am on Sunday.

We've lived this personally. As a 3 year old, super lean fintech team running all our own finances, we know what it's like trying to keep the finances afloat while doing everything else it takes to make it big. It's not like the work is rocket science. It's just constant, manual, nagging, and spread across 18 different tools that need sense making.

Until recently, you had to pay $10,000 a month to hire a finance function. We'd like to change that.

brumby.name: Brumby (Formerly GrazeMate)

Robot Cowboys that Herd Cattle with AI Drones

Brumby builds autonomous drones that herd cattle.

On command, our drones fly to a paddock, position themselves around the mob, and move them where they need to go. What used to take a full day of helicopters, motorbikes, and horses now runs on a schedule.

We work with some of the largest cattle ranches in the world. While the drones are herding, they're also estimating animal weights, measuring grass biomass, monitoring water levels, and flagging sick animals. We're building physical AI that lets a grazier manage thousands of head across millions of acres from their phone.

brumby.what_they_sell: Autonomous drone fleet that herds cattle, monitors herd health (weight estimation, sick animal detection), measures pasture biomass, and tracks water levels. Graziers control operations via mobile app; drones execute herding tasks autonomously on schedule.
brumby.ai_play: AI-driven autonomous control of multi-agent drone swarms to execute complex herding behavior in unstructured outdoor environments. Computer vision + RL enables drones to learn optimal positioning and movement patterns to move livestock efficiently. Sensor fusion (cameras, thermal, LiDAR) provides real-time herd state and pasture intelligence, replacing manual helicopter/motorbike labor.

buildbox.name: Buildbox
buildbox.one_liner: Understand how users experience your AI agents

Understand how users experience your AI agents

Buildbox helps product teams improve the human-agent experience. We analyze user intent, agent behavior, and outcomes to find where users get stuck or lose trust, then turn those findings into ranked, reproducible issues. 

Find the user-facing agent failures hidden behind successful traces and evals.

TL;DR: An agent can pass its evals and look healthy in traces while still failing to help users complete important tasks. Buildbox identifies those failed user journeys, ties them to business outcomes, and tests better agent behaviors and interaction patterns. Product teams get evidence-backed fixes they can review and ship.

Ask: If you’re building a customer-facing AI agent, we’ll help you find the agent failures you haven’t seen yet. Book 20 minutes with us: cal.com/team/buildbox/discovery

www.youtube.com/watch?v=Er_CW5WS6Lw

The problem: the most expensive agent failures rarely look like errors.

buildbox.industry_sub_vertical: AI agent observability & user experience analytics
buildbox.what_they_sell: Analytics and observability platform that monitors human-agent interactions, analyzes user intent and agent behavior, identifies failure points and trust breakdowns, and surfaces ranked, reproducible issues for product teams to fix.
buildbox.ai_play: Uses AI to analyze conversation logs, user intent patterns, and agent decision traces to automatically detect where users get stuck, lose confidence, or abandon interactions. Transforms raw interaction data into structured insights and actionable debugging information for product teams.

burnt.name: burnt
burnt.one_liner: Agentic Operating System for Food Supply Chain
burnt.description:
Agentic Operating System for Food Supply Chain

Food Supply Chain companies have been using legacy ERPs for decades. Everyone knows these are necessary evils that essentially run the business but take up a lot of operational capacity. They are not about to just rip and replace their existing system that runs their whole business with a system that takes years to implement. Imagine if they could implement AI that runs the ERP for them, in weeks?

Burnt’s building an agentic OS for the Food Supply Chain with AI Agents for each department. 

Our AI Agent, Ozai, has started by replacing the whole order management job function at food distribution companies, so that sales and customer service teams can focus on what matters - the customer. Ozai monitors all incoming messages (emails, phone calls, voicemails, whatsapp, fax etc.), figures out if it's an order, learns each customer's habits, shorthand, and favorite products, picks up on any prep notes, and enters it straight into the existing ERP. It'll even go back to the customers on your behalf when it's not sure about something, clarify things and carry on working. 

The more it sees, the smarter it gets.
burnt.industry_sub_vertical: Food distribution order management and fulfillment automation

The agent ingests orders from multiple channels (email, phone, WhatsApp, fax), learns customer preferences and shorthand, clarifies ambiguities autonomously, and writes directly into existing legacy ERP systems without requiring rip-and-replace.
burnt.ai_play: AI agent replaces the entire order management job function by handling multi-channel order intake, customer context learning, and ERP data entry. Reduces operational overhead for sales and customer service teams while integrating seamlessly with incumbent legacy systems (no migration risk). Agent improves over time as it sees more customer patterns.

callbook-ai.name: Callbook AI
callbook-ai.one_liner: AI collections agency for late stage portfolios
callbook-ai.description:
AI collections agency for late stage portfolios

Callbook AI is a collections agency operated by AI. We collect late stage portfolios by finding, contacting and negotiating with borrowers.

We find hard-to-reach borrowers, understand their situation, and negotiate using AI voice, email and SMS.

We are a collections agency entirely run by AI.

We have found out that the most effective way to collect a portfolio is by first doing a deep research to locate and understand each person´s situation, and then negotiate with them. 

As a result, we've consistently outperformed every competing collection solutions.



Today, we’re negotiating with 100K+ people every week. We’ve delivered historic recovery at every company we’ve worked with and won 100% of our head-to-head pilots against competing solutions.

Founders Diego and Daniel bring experience across machine learning and B2B products. Diego has published two peer-reviewed papers on on-device deep learning and TinyML with Elsevier, has 6+ years of experience in embedded ML, and previously built Audi’s e-commerce platform at CI&T.

callbook-ai.ai_play: AI agents replace traditional collections staff by automating borrower identification (data enrichment + skip-tracing), multi-channel outreach (calls, SMS, email), negotiation logic, and payment coordination. Agents handle high-volume, repetitive contact workflows at software-like margins while taking contractual responsibility for recovery outcomes.

cambioml.name: CambioML
cambioml.one_liner: A fresh, independent AI agent that re-verifies every number in your AI results and shows its work — so trusting AI stops being a leap of faith.
cambioml.description:
A fresh, independent AI agent that re-verifies every number in your AI results and shows its work — so trusting AI stops being a leap of faith.

Hey everyone! We're Rachel and Kimi, founders of Energent.ai. We're excited (and honestly, a little proud) to introduce our newest feature: Energent Audit.

## 🚀 TL;DR

Energent Audit is a built-in, independent second opinion for your for every AI-generated results, especially numbers. Ask Energent to "prove it," "double-check that," or "show me where this number came from," and Audit spins up a completely fresh sub-agent — one with zero stake in the original answer — to retrace every number back to its source and hand you a clean HTML report on whether it holds up.

## ❌ The Problem

AI hallucination hasn't gone away — it's just gotten quieter. It shows up in the reports people care about most: financial analysis, health recommendations, board decks, the numbers real decisions get built on.

We interviewed 150+ users doing serious work with AI, and hallucination came back as their second-biggest concern overall — right after data security and privacy, and ahead of cost, speed, and everything else. The message was clear: people don't just want AI that's fast. They want AI they can stand behind.

## 🛠️ Our Solution

Meet Energent Audit — an independent audit layer for anything Energent builds for you.

Here's the insight at the heart of it: the agent that wrote an answer is the worst-positioned agent to grade it. So instead of asking Energent to mark its own homework, Audit calls in a brand-new AI sub-agent with no memory of how the analysis was built and no attachment to th
cambioml.industry_sub_vertical: AI output verification & audit infrastructure for high-stakes decision-making
cambioml.what_they_sell: An independent audit layer (Energent Audit) that deploys a fresh AI sub-agent to re-verify and fact-check outputs from other AI systems, particularly numerical results and claims. Provides HTML audit reports tracing numbers back to source data.
cambioml.ai_play: Uses agentic AI to solve the AI hallucination problem by creating an independent verification agent with zero stake in the original answer. The audit agent retraces reasoning, validates sources, and produces verifiable proof-of-work reports. Transforms trust from a 'leap of faith' into a verifiable, auditable process.

candor.name: Candor
candor.one_liner: We help companies win government funding with AI
candor.description:
We help companies win government funding with AI

Candor helps defense and deeptech companies navigate the government procurement process with AI. We inject agents into the procurement process - agents that not only surface opportunities but actively pursue them - giving anyone the same capabilities as large contractors. 

When we met at Stanford 4 years ago, it was rare for startups to work with the US Government. In the years that we’ve been involved in the burgeoning Defense Tech ecosystem, a lot has changed. Silicon Valley and the US Government are closer than they’ve been in decades.  

As fellows in Stanford’s Center for National Security Innovation, we’ve had the privilege of speaking with dozens of government officials who have come to Silicon Valley looking to fund and scale startups solving their most urgent problems. 

However, we’ve seen firsthand the struggles these startups face in securing gov funding. Marcus, having spoken with dozens of defense startups in his time helping lead the Stanford Defense Tech Club and trying to set up a national security startup accelerator has seen this especially.

That’s why we’re making it easier to find and apply for opportunities, taking the application process from weeks to days.

We’re only going to see more cooperation in the coming years. With that, there will be increasingly more funding going towards companies in defense, energy, biotech, quantum, etc. Candor lets you unlock that funding potential.

Replaces manual procurement labor with autonomous agents that level the playing field between startups and large contractors.

Candor changes this by telling your security team exactly who to watch before they cause damage. Zero tuning, detection from day one, and it actually learns from analyst feedback.

cardamon.name: Cardamon
cardamon.one_liner: AI compliance co-pilot for regulated financial businesses
cardamon.description:
AI compliance co-pilot for regulated financial businesses

Cardamon is an AI powered platform that ingests relevant regulation, understands what applies to each regulated financial firm, and gets compliance officers from regulation, to obligations, to product requirements in minutes - not weeks.

Financial firms face a host of complex regulations that make it incredibly painful to launch and maintain products in a compliant way. As a Product team at Revolut, we felt this pain deeply ourselves - we had products ready to launch but stuck in compliance limbo, often for weeks. Turns out, getting compliant took as long as building the product itself. 

Frustrated, we dug in and were shocked by how manual and inefficient the processes were. That’s when it clicked: there’s a huge opportunity to automate the boring stuff (and solve our own problem!). Compliance teams win because they ditch the tedious tasks. Product teams win because they ship faster. Everyone’s happy.

Reduces compliance officer toil and accelerates product launch cycles.

cardboard.name: Cardboard
cardboard.description:
Agentic video editor

Cardboard is an agentic video editor for growth/marketing teams and serious creators who need to ship videos consistently. Instead of agencies, long timelines, and infinite review cycles, teams give cardboard a footage + a goal (“3 variants”, “30s hook”, “testimonials”) to get a strong first cut in minutes on which they can iterate quickly.

Multimodal LLMs can finally reason over footage, and WebGPU/WebCodecs make a real NLE possible in the browser. For the first time, an “AI director” inside a professional editor can be a reality.

We have to build two hard things at once: a high-performance editor in the browser and an agentic editor that is reliable for production use cases. Most startups do one; incumbents can’t rebuild their stack without breaking everything.

Saksham and Ishan met in school and have known each other since 15 years. Saksham was Co-founder/CTO of Iterate AI (backed by EF) and posts content on social media; Ishan has spent ~5yr building memory-heavy, performance-critical browser apps at HackerRank (S11) and deeply understands browsers. He has built Hotspoter (5M+ downloads) when he was 14.

Together, we’re unusually suited to build the editor core others avoid.

Video is becoming the default distribution channel, and the team that iterates fastest compounds attention. Cardboard becomes the default workspace for video production, the way Canva/Figma became the workspace for design - because it’s collaborative, fast, and does the tedious parts for you.

Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running.

We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production.

As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "t

Deploy to secure enclaves in minutes, isolate sensitive workloads, cryptographically prove what code is running.

Hey everyone! We're Anton Livaja, Lance Vick, and Ksenia Lesko from Caution.

Building browser agents with current frameworks seems promising until you hit production. The observation-action loop - where LLMs observe, reason, and act at runtime - is slow, expensive, and hard to debug.

Our platform uses two specialized agents: a Builder Agent that converts your business process description into a deterministic browser automation workflow, and a Maintenance Agent that fixes broken workflows once they’re in production.

The Builder Agent takes your workflow description (or an existing SOP) and generates an automation workflow. You watch it work in real-time and clarify edge cases. Credentials are stored securely in your vault.

The Maintenance Agent keeps scripts alive in production. When a payer portal changes its selectors, adds a popup, or goes down, the Maintenance Agent detects it, classifies the error, and fixes it automatically. Complex issues escalate to a human.

Why this architecture wins
LLM costs are amortized over thousands of runs instead of paid on every step. Once in production, workflows are versionable, behave consistently and run at browser-native speed.

Corgea AI Pentesting: an autonomous penetration testing engine that uses AI agents to plan, execute, validate, and report security tests. It doesn’t run a checklist. It reasons about your application.



## The numbers

In a recent pentest:

* Corgea found 25 findings. The human pentester found 6.
* Delivery time: 4-8 hours. The human pentest took 2 weeks.



## How it works

Most autonomous pentesting tools are black-box scanners with better marketing. They probe endpoints against a generic vulnerability checklist and produce a PDF full of theoretical findings that security teams have to triage manually.

Corgea takes a fundamentally different approach. The engine operates like a real pentesting team.

Multi-agent architecture. Not a single scanner. Corgea spawns a coordinator agent that assigns specialized sub-agents (an authentication discovery agent, an API exploration agent, a SQL injection expert agent) based on what it discovers. These agents collaborate, share findings, and build on each other’s discoveries. For complex targets, Corgea can spawn hundreds of agents.



Code-aware, not black-box. The engine ingests code context, dependency data, infrastructure configuration, and business logic. It uses your existing AI SAST findings for white-box pentesting, exploiting vulnerabilities at runtime that static analysis already identified. This combination of static insight and dynamic testing dramatically amplifies what the engine can find.

Dynamic adaptation. Corgea’s ag

Integrations make products capable. Integrations are also frustrating to write. If you look at any codebase with integrations, 95% of the code is identical. It's all just basic plumbing. #  Coverage Cat AI Insurance Bench

We’re Coverage Cat. We built an AI insurance benchmark to measure how frontier models perform on real insurance workflows, not trivia or generic reasoning tasks.

### TL;DR



Coverage Cat’s AI Insurance Benchmark compares 7 frontier models on two insurance-specific evals:

* Price estimation: can a model estimate umbrella insurance quote ranges accurately?
* Brokerage/Agent task: can a model answer practical insurance questions the way a good broker or agent would?

The public leaderboard ranks models by Elo Rating, Win Rate, Quote Coverage, Quote MAPE, Winkler Loss, and judged brokerage-task quality.

View it here: Coverage Cat AI Insurance Benchmark ()

### The Problem

Most AI benchmarks don’t tell you whether a model is useful inside a real insurance workflow or whether consumers can really trust it for insurance information.

Insurance work is full of messy edge cases: pricing uncertainty, underwriting rules, coverage terminology, household risk factors, and questions where the answer needs to be both correct and concise.

There has been good prior work on insurance AI benchmarks, including UNDERWRITE, which evaluates multi-turn underwriting agents with domain experts, noisy tools, and simulated users. That work focuses on enterprise underwriting agent behavior and found meaningful gaps between general model performance and enterprise readiness.

Our benchmark is different: it focuses on consumer insurance workflows Coverage Cat actua

dimely.name: Dimely
dimely.one_liner: The most powerful Trace Precedents tool for Google Sheets. As AI generates more formulas, SheetWhiz helps you trace, verify, and catch mistakes before they lead to bad decisions.
dimely.description:
The most powerful Trace Precedents tool for Google Sheets. As AI generates more formulas, SheetWhiz helps you trace, verify, and catch mistakes before they lead to bad decisions. 

## TL;DR

AI is going to generate more of your spreadsheet analysis.

That is powerful, but it creates a new problem: if AI writes the analysis, who catches the mistakes?

SheetWhiz helps you audit the logic behind your spreadsheet work before you rely on it. You can trace where numbers come from, understand how formulas flow through your model, verify that calculations make sense, and catch mistakes before they lead to bad decisions.

Under the hood, SheetWhiz gives you the most powerful Trace Precedents and Trace Dependents workflow in Google Sheets, with multi-level formula tracing, step-by-step formula evaluation, and AI built into the audit flow.

SheetWhiz is already used by over 10,000 professionals at some of the most productive companies in the world, including Anthropic, DoorDash, Robinhood, Chime, and GitLab.

Try SheetWhiz free from the Chrome Web Store.

## The Problem

AI is making it easier than ever to create spreadsheet analysis.

It can write formulas, build models, summarize data, and automate workflows that used to take hours. That is a huge productivity unlock, especially for teams that live in spreadsheets.

But it also creates a new risk: people will start shipping analysis they do not fully understand.

And even the best AI-generated spreadsheet work still needs review.

Wall Street Prep recently tested leading AI tools for financial modeling against investment banking standards. Even the winning tool scored only 5.7 / 10 on accuracy of data extraction
dimely.industry_sub_vertical: AI-generated spreadsheet formula verification & audit logging
dimely.what_they_sell: Chrome extension for Google Sheets that provides advanced formula tracing, precedent/dependent analysis, step-by-step formula evaluation, and AI-powered audit workflows to verify and catch errors in spreadsheet logic before decisions are made.
dimely.ai_play: As AI generates more spreadsheet formulas and models, SheetWhiz uses AI to help users audit, trace, and verify the correctness of AI-generated (and human-written) analysis. Solves the trust gap: AI writes the formula, SheetWhiz helps you verify it's correct before shipping.

dipole-labs.one_liner: AI-controlled optical switching for AI clusters
dipole-labs.description:
AI-controlled optical switching for AI clusters

High-speed optical circuit switches that keep data moving as light, giving AI clusters up to 25% more useful compute from the same hardware.

The most expensive computers ever built spend about half their time waiting for data. As AI clusters scale, it's increasingly the network that limits how much compute you can actually use.

What we're building Dipole Labs builds high-speed optical circuit switches for AI data centers. Between racks, data already travels as light, but routing it usually means converting it to electricity and back, burning power, generating heat, and adding latency. Dipole's switch keeps data in the optical domain, targeting sub-microsecond reconfiguration at large port counts, so the network can reshape itself around each workload.

An AI-native control layer learns GPU communication patterns and synchronizes optical reconfiguration with training and inference, turning the network into an active accelerator

dipole-labs.what_they_sell: AI-controlled optical switching hardware and control plane for high-performance AI cluster interconnects. dipole-labs.ai_play: AI agents autonomously manage optical switch configuration, predict traffic patterns, optimize routing decisions, and adapt network topology in real-time based on cluster workload characteristics. Replaces manual network engineering and static routing with learned, adaptive control.

To scale, we anchor permanent infrastructure in orbit - building high power Autonomous Space Stations designed from day one for "lights-out" manufacturing serviced by the reentry vehicles.

Donkey is the modern trading company. We buy straight from Chinese factories and sell delivered to US importers: one USD price to their dock, duty paid, our own inspectors on the factory floor before the factory gets paid.

Donkey turns the container into a cart. Upload your buying list and see every landed price instantly, tariffs and delivery included. Our engine packs the order, and when the load needs a bigger box, a second container steps in. When you sign, the price holds.

You buy from Donkey. One contract, one company responsible for everything between the factory floor and your door. If costs move under your locked price, that's our problem. And our own people are on those factory floors, checking what goes into the box before it ships.

duranium.name: Duranium
duranium.description:
Reshoring critical metal production

China and Russia control the world’s critical minerals. We can produce Titanium, Magnesium, Aluminum, Zirconium & Hafnium in the U.S. more profitably than any existing process, and carbon neutrally via co-production.

Carbochlorination is the primary process for producing critical metals like titanium, hafnium, and zirconium, and was once the standard for magnesium. The problem: conventional carbochlorination relies on purchasing carbon feedstocks, wastes valuable byproducts, and is highly CO₂-intensive.

Duranium changes this with a novel reactor that recycles CO₂ emissions back into feedstock (CO) while generating a valuable co-product (bleaching agents). This closed loop slashes emissions and delivers Chinese-level metal pricing without subsidies — unlocking the full potential of carbochlorination for U.S. critical mineral production.
duranium.industry_sub_vertical: Critical minerals production equipment & process technology (titanium, magnesium, zirconium, hafnium carbochlorination reactors)
duranium.what_they_sell: Novel carbochlorination reactor hardware + process IP for reshoring critical metal production (titanium, magnesium, zirconium, hafnium) in the U.S. with closed-loop CO₂ recycling and co-product generation.
duranium.ai_play: AI likely optimizes reactor control, feedstock routing, thermal management, and byproduct recovery in real-time. Machine learning may accelerate materials science R&D (alloy composition, process parameters) and predict reactor performance under variable conditions. AI is an enabler of manufacturing precision and operational efficiency, not the primary product SKU.

There's a gap between what AI agents can do and what your product can offer.

f4-industries.name: F4 Industries
f4-industries.one_liner: The GD&T Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings
f4-industries.description:
The GD&T Analysis Platform for Engineering Drawings

GD&T takes years to master. Engineers must encode their design intent into a dense syntax that manufacturers must decode, and not everyone gets it right. 

Put ten engineers in front of the same drawing and you may get ten different interpretations. Which means errors often surface later in interface stack-ups, manufacturing, or in the field - when they’re far more expensive to fix.

That’s why we built F4 - the platform that analyzes GD&T to determine whether your designs are ready for production.

Drop in your drawing and 3D file. F4 analyzes every element of your GD&T to assess whether your design is clear, manufacturable, and production ready. To make the drawing easier to understand, engineers can visualize their datums, reference frames, and tolerance zones directly on the 3D model. F4 also calculates tolerance stack-ups instantly - directly from the drawing. What once took hours of manual work now takes seconds.

When issues are found, F4 flags them and guides engineers toward resolving the problem.

After analyzing your drawing, F4 also automatically generates design and inspection reports - stack-up tables, FAI reports - ready to share with your team.

And it does all of this locally on-device with no AI used for analysis. Producing deterministic results engineers can trust.

f4-industries.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that analyzes GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) in engineering drawings and 3D CAD files to validate design clarity, manufacturability, and production readiness. Generates tolerance stack-ups, design reports, and FAI documentation automatically.
f4-industries.ai_play: AI/ML models trained on engineering best practices and manufacturing constraints analyze drawing semantics, detect GD&T errors, ambiguities, and stack-up issues that would otherwise require hours of manual expert review. Deterministic analysis (no black-box inference) produces results engineers can trust and act on. Reduces design iteration cycles and catches manufacturing defects before production.

- Nyx attacks itself through adversarial self-play, retaining successful jailbreaks and using them to generate stronger variants. This creates a continuous search for novel attacks rather than replaying a fixed set of payloads which compounds over time; thus massively improving its capabilities.
- It can interact directly with chat, voice, browser, and coding agents without source code or a special integration. It can also attack indirectly through controlled replicas of SaaS products and websites that we maintain, placing

Every orthopedic surgeon we've talked to says the same thing: 90%+ of expensive implants they use are clinically interchangeable, but the choice comes down to habit, brand comfort, or the device rep. US surgery centers spend ~$7B a year on implants, and in orthopedic and spine cases the implant alone runs ~40-60% of the total cost of the procedure. Roughly ~20-30% of that spend is recoverable by switching to a clinically-equivalent device. Instead of defaulting to the implant they trained on, a surgeon sees the 3+ equivalent options side by side and switches to the one that protects the case's margin.

Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.

At a big hospital the surgeon picks the implant but isn't spending their own money, so price doesn't impact the decision. At an independent surgery center the physicians own the economics, so a cheaper equivalent goes straight to their bottom line. They have every incentive to switch. They just don't have the information or the tooling.

frigade.name: Frigade
frigade.one_liner: Frigade learns your product by using it, then takes real actions for your users through Skills your team approves with no code.
frigade.description:
Frigade learns your product by using it, then takes real actions for your users through Skills your team approves with no code.

Hi everyone, Eric and Christian here, co-founders of Frigade (W23).

Frigade is an AI agent that lives inside your product and guides users through it. Point it at your app and it learns your UI in minutes. You don't wire anything up or write docs.

Today we're launching a major new upgrade to our agent called Skills.

So far, Frigade has guided users and answered their questions. With Skills, it can take real actions for them too: looking things up, creating, editing, deleting.

Skills are the actions Frigade figures out on its own while it trains on your product. It documents each one, your team approves it with no code from the dashboard, and from then on Frigade runs it for any user who needs it. You can still wire in your own custom tool calls with our SDK, too.



If you've used Linear's AI agent, Frigade is that as an embed: the same kind of in-app agent, dropped into your product with one snippet. You get about 80% of it out of the box, with no eng work required.

How it works:

1. Add the snippet. Frigade starts using your product and learns it, like a new user would.
2. It turns the actions it finds into Skills. Your team reviews and approves them, no code.
3. Frigade runs those Skills for your users and answers their questions as they go.

Here it is running on popular products we don't embed in.

We just pointed it at each one and let it learn to see how it performed:

* Jira
* Spotify
* Hacker News

Frigade is best for:

* Teams drowning in "how do I..." tickets

frigade.ai_play: AI learns product UI through interaction (like a new user), auto-discovers repeatable actions, surfaces them for human approval, then executes those actions autonomously for end-users. Our goal is to make personalised cancer treatment accessible to every dog that needs it- and use each case to improve the treatment for the next

Input the tumour. Output the vaccine. 300+ dogs on the waitlist.

We believe that AI meets biology is the biggest opportunity of the 21st century. We are using AI to build autonomous systems that read biological failure, discover how to control it, and design precise repairs. We are starting with the first computationally personalised mRNA cancer vaccine for dogs.

My dog Rosie was dying of cancer. I designed her an mRNA vaccine. Several of her tumours shrank 50-75%. I am not a biologist - I spent 17 years in machine learning. The shared learning layer for agents.

Hey everyone! I'm Nikos, the founder of Glen.

TL;DR

Glen is building the organizational learning and context layer for agents.

Every agent session your team runs produces reasoning worth keeping, and nearly all of it is discarded the moment the window closes.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1T0CkjYfo3k3FB40_R7UPNfONO-SdgfKB

Glen is the layer that unifies every agent and model your company run. Glen pulls in agent sessions from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, plus Slack messages, GitHub prs, tickets, docs and calls. handoff.description:
Autonomous takeoffs, available today via API

TL;DR: H1 reads construction blueprints and produces a complete material takeoff autonomously, from the raw PDF. It scores 81.6% on our benchmark — ahead of human estimators (77.6%) and \~20 points clear of the best frontier model. It runs in \~2 hours vs. up to a week for a human.




The problem

Before a contractor can bid a job, someone has to do a takeoff: read every sheet, count materials trade by trade, measure walls and roofs, cross-reference dimensions that live on different pages. It takes an experienced estimator 8–20 hours per project and years of training to do at all. It's the tax on every bid in a huge, fragmented industry.

You'd think a frontier model could do this now. It can't. Foundation models today aren't capable of understanding construction drawings to a level that is actually useful for a construction business. So this massive $2 trillion industry still runs on blueprints that are being analyzed by humans pretty much the same way they have been for the last few hundred years.

What we built

Handoff has developed H1: an AI model that understands and analyzes blueprints better than a human estimator, thus resolving this manual bottleneck once and for all.



H1 has three layers:

* Scope analysis — a detailed, trade-by-trade breakdown of what the project actually involves, read straight from the drawings.
* Takeoff with quantities — a complete material quantity list per trade: framing members, sheets, linear and square footage, counts, all with units.

hemlock.name: Hemlock
hemlock.one_liner: Force-sensing wristband for training robotic AI
hemlock.description:
Force-sensing wristband for training robotic AI

Every serious robotics lab is bottlenecked on the same thing: demonstration data. The field has converged on egocentric video and hand pose as the substrate, and both are now cheap to collect at scale. What neither of them contains is force. A video of someone picking up an egg and a video of someone picking up a rock are nearly identical in pixel space and nearly identical in joint angles. They differ almost entirely in a quantity nobody is recording. Policies trained without it learn geometry and inherit no sense of touch.

Hemlock closes that gap at the source. Our device, the Bracelet, is a wrist-worn surface EMG band that reads the electrical activity of the forearm muscles that actually drive the hand, which means it recovers contraction force directly rather than inferring it from motion. This distinction is the whole thesis: force cannot be reconstructed downstream of kinematics, because a hand squeezing hard isometrically and a hand resting can occupy the identical pose. Muscle signal is the only non-invasive channel that separates them.

hemlock.what_they_sell: Wrist-worn surface EMG sensor (Bracelet) that captures force/muscle activation data during human demonstrations for robotic AI training. Provides the missing modality (force/touch) that video and pose estimation alone cannot capture.
hemlock.ai_play: Enables training of robotic manipulation policies with tactile/force awareness by closing the gap in demonstration data. Force information is critical for policies to learn contact-sensitive tasks (grasping, assembly, delicate handling) that video + kinematics alone cannot teach. Hemlock's hardware captures the ground truth signal (muscle contraction → force) that downstream RL/imitation learning models need to generalize beyond geometry to physics-aware control.

herdr.name: herdr
herdr.description:
building the open agent runtime

Developers don't run one coding agent anymore. They run fleets of them — for hours, sometimes days — across laptops, servers, and sandboxes. Keeping track of that work is the new bottleneck: which agent is blocked, which one finished, which terminal is it in, and why did everything die when the laptop closed.

Herdr is the open-source home for that work. A background server owns the agents' terminal sessions on each machine, so the work survives disconnects, closed lids, and dropped SSH. Herdr detects each agent and turns the chaos into an attention queue — working, blocked, done, across every project — so you look only when an agent needs you. Every client is just a view: the bundled terminal UI, SSH from another machine, your phone. Close one, open another; the work never stops.

Software can drive it too: a CLI, a socket API, and a plugin marketplace that passed 500 community plugins in its first month. The runtime is Apache-2.0 and stays open. Four months after launch: 25k GitHub stars, 340k downloads.

Provides persistent background server that manages agent terminal sessions across distributed machines (laptops, servers, sandboxes), survives disconnects/network failures, and surfaces agent state (working, blocked, done) as an attention queue. Monetizes via OSS adoption + commercial hosting, plugins, and enterprise features.
herdr.ai_play: Solves the 'fleet management' problem: developers deploying multiple long-running coding agents need reliable session persistence, state tracking, and unified observability. Herdr abstracts away infrastructure chaos (closed laptops, dropped SSH, terminal fragmentation) so agents can run reliably for hours/days. CLI, socket API, and plugin marketplace enable programmatic control and ecosystem extensibility.

What is Webskillet.ai?

Webskillet is a single API for web automation - extracting data, downloading files, crawling sites, filling forms, research tasks. You send a task in plain English (plus optional parameters, output schema, and start URL), and an agent executes it in a real browser using code.

That code is saved as a skillet, and since most web automation is repeat work (the same task on a schedule, or the same task with different parameters), the skillet gets reused on every later run. That's why run 2 can be 4x faster and cheaper than run 1. Here are 20 real tasks with run 1 vs. run 2 numbers.

Why this is different?

Pure AI browser agents treat every run like the first one. Nothing transfers: the agent re-explores, re-reasons, and you pay full price in time and tokens every time. Fine for one-offs, but web automation is mostly repeat work.

Webskillet captures what the agent learns as code in the skillet, so run 2 starts from a working solution instead of a blank browser. And it's code reuse, not caching: same skillet, new parameters, fresh data from the live site.



Our story

We've been building Intuned for the past 3 years: a browser automation platform that's been powerful for our customers, but it takes some setup to get up and running. Meanwhile, the world is moving to a place where agents just want everything as an API.

Webskillet is our new product: everything we learned, packaged differently. One endpoint, no

Agents write code once; code executes 4x faster and cheaper on repeat tasks.
intuned.ai_play: AI agent generates task-specific automation code in run 1; code is persisted as a 'skillet' and executed directly (not re-reasoned) on runs 2+. Eliminates token waste and latency from re-exploration on repeat web automation tasks. Bridges gap between pure agentic reasoning (expensive per-run) and static scripts (brittle on site changes).

kaelio.name: Kaelio

kaelio.description:
The open-source context layer for data agents

Kaelio is the company behind ktx, the open-source context layer that makes data agents reliable. 

Data agents today fail because they lack structured context and determinism. Metrics are defined in five places, governed in none. Teams spend months on semantic layer projects that never finish.

ktx fixes that. Connect your warehouse, BI tools, and docs. ktx builds the context layer automatically. Your team governs it. Any agent can query it. One context layer across your entire data stack.

kalinda.name: Kalinda
kalinda.one_liner: Deep research for class action law firms
kalinda.description:
Deep research for class action law firms

Kalinda helps class action law firms qualify potential cases in minutes with AI.

The nature of class action/mass torts involves thousands of cases for a single lawsuit. For every plaintiff (injured person), law firms involved in these cases compile everything from the products they used to the injuries they have. This data is extensive, granular, and buried deep in thousands of pages of medical, financial, and employment records and others.

Kalinda extracts, summarizes, and aggregates data from these records for attorneys with AI.

When scaled across an entire litigation, Kalinda works tirelessly and in parallel—turning a process that once took months into just a few hours. 

Kalinda provides firms with the equivalent manpower of hundreds of paralegals and legal nurses, allowing them to quickly determine which claimants are eligible and helping them file faster and in greater volume.

To date, we’ve processed 600k pages of records and are live with 2 of the largest plaintiff law firms in the U.S!

kestral.name: Kestral
kestral.one_liner: We automate your entire product development lifecycle.
kestral.description:
We automate your entire product development lifecycle.

Kestral makes it clear what your customers want most, prioritizes those tasks for highest leverage, and closes the loop with those customers.

We (Brian and Bernard) have been close friends since university, and most recently worked together at Asana, leading AI and Authorization efforts. There we realized AI can completely disrupt the $50B Work Management Market, but it required a fresh start.

What work we even choose to manage in the first place is critical, and the most important insights from customers are silo-ed in sales/CS while R&D gives their best shot at roadmaps meant to deliver impact. Significant requests sit in a backlog, duplicate asks flood the system, months wasted on "strategic investments". We want to bridge this gap.

This message is resonating with heads of sales, heads of product, CEOs, as well as individuals, all trying to make sure the most important things get done, with less wasted effort and more revenue/retention.

Kestral works by automatically take in customer data like sales call transcripts & feature request messages and a team of agents:
1. analyze them for actionable takeaways, deal blockers, and nice to haves
2. consolidate them and manage all the asks with citations
3. prioritize them by impact and frequency to cut through the noise so you can see the biggest opportunities clearly
4. connect them to your existing strategic roadmap so when the work gets done, we can automatically follow back up with your customers and win them over

This is just step one of our mission to revolutionize how work gets done -- starting with what we choose to work on, and hope you follow us along for the ride!

kestral.ai_play: AI agents replace manual, time-intensive work of product managers and heads of product who currently manually parse sales/CS data, consolidate duplicate requests, and prioritize roadmaps. Agents handle ingestion (transcripts, messages), analysis (NLP extraction of intent/impact), consolidation (deduplication with citations), and closed-loop customer engagement (auto-follow-up). Reduces roadmap planning cycle time and eliminates information silos between sales/CS and R&D.

### why we built keystroke (our pivot story)

Hey everyone, we’re Blake and Dallin from Keystroke. Keystroke is a recent pivot from Buster, our original YC W24 idea.



At Buster, we spent a lot of time building internal agents and automations. We used visual platforms like n8n and Gumloop, as well as code-first tools like Trigger.dev, Mastra, and several of Vercel’s open frameworks. We genuinely liked many of them, but kept encountering two different problems:

1. Visual tools gave us integrations, credentials, hosting, and an application the rest of the team could use. They were fast initially, but became difficult to maintain as the systems grew. Tests and typechecks were limited, JSON blobs were hard to review, and debugging failures was painful.
2. Code-first tools gave us ordinary TypeScript, tests, npm packages, and a codebase that coding agents could work with directly. But after building something, we were deploying it to infrastructure rather than an application people could use. We still needed to configure the chat UI, streaming, credentials, integrations, run history, permissions, and sharing ourselves.

So, we started building the thing we wish existed: a code-first fra

keystroke.ai_play: Keystroke bridges the gap between code-first agent frameworks (Mastra, Trigger.dev) and visual workflow platforms (n8n, Gumloop) by enabling developers to write agents in TypeScript while automatically providing a deployable application layer, eliminating the need to build hosting, UI, credentials, and team collaboration infrastructure separately.

Before Kinro, Pierre-Alexandre was an AI researcher at De…

kinter.description:
Kinter.ai is an autonomous workforce for accounting teams

I started coding at 10 and working professionally at 17. Five years ago, I built Alloy Automation (YC W20), an integration platform backed by a16z and YC that connected SaaS tools and powered financial workflows for companies like Amazon.

Last year, I made a call that felt risky: walked away from a growing business because I could see the moat eroding. Integration infrastructure was getting commoditized. We pivoted to Kinter.ai.

Here's what we saw: The real problem in accounting is execution capacity, not data. Most finance teams close their books 14-21 days after month-end – not because they lack information, but because the work (reconciliation, accruals, journal entries) still happens manually. Every "AI" tool in the space is basically a co-pilot: you ask it something, it helps you do the work faster. The work still lands on a person.

What we built: AI agents that run accounting workflows proactively, inside existing ERPs (QuickBooks and NetSuite), without waiting to be prompted. One agent does payroll. Another monitors for accruals throughout the month and drafts proposals. Another reads invoice attachments to extract prepaid expense candidates. All actions go through a human approval step before touching the books. Full audit trail on everything.

Automate credit review for lenders in emerging markets

Most of the population is traditionally unbanked, banking APIs don’t exist, and a borrower’s financial history lives in documents: e-wallet records, bank statements, utility bills, and more. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume. 

Kita is the AI platform for global lending operations. We help lenders in emerging markets automate application completion, document verification, and underwriting from messy financial documents — using AI to extract fraud-checked data and localized risk signals that power faster, better credit decisions.

Under the hood, Kita is a learning engine. We link document-level signals to repayment outcomes, allowing our models to continuously improve fraud detection and risk assessment over time. This creates a compounding advantage for lenders as their distinct underwriting decisions feed back into the system.

We’re Carmel and Rhea. We met before Stanford and have been building together ever since. Carmel is from Manila, is a repeat founder, and spent three years in product at Apple. Rhea has a research background in computer vision and received the highest honor in Stanford Computer Science. Together, we combine deep local context with strong technical execution to build the infrastructure that expands access to credit in emerging markets.

Enterprise legal asks "who pays if your agent breaks something?" and there's no good answer.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        
We built the answer. Critical-category risk evaluation, certification, financial guarantee, liability insurance and the documentation enterprise procurement needs to sign off.

Libretto is an open-source CLI that lets agents turn website workflows into fast, reusable scripts you can deploy

The problem: Most browser automation tools work by sending an AI agent to operate a website in real time, like a robot typing and clicking on your behalf. This is slow, expensive, and unpredictable. They rely on fragile DOM parsing that breaks on legacy and complex sites, and you can never fully trust what the agent will do on unintuitive or inconsistent workflows.

Our approach: Libretto helps your coding agents generate workflows as actual, readable code during development, not at runtime. Under the hood it combines Playwright with direct in-session network/API calls for reliability and bot detection evasion. It also supports step-through debugging and a read-only mode to prevent accidental data changes while your agent builds and debugs workflows.

This makes Libretto cheaper, faster, and easier to maintain, especially for more complex websites and high stakes workflows.
libretto.industry_sub_vertical: Agent web workflow automation & API generation for healthcare operations
libretto.what_they_sell: Open-source CLI + commercial SaaS that converts website workflows into reliable, maintainable code (APIs/scripts) that agents can execute deterministically. Combines Playwright with direct API calls to replace fragile DOM-based browser automation.
libretto.ai_play: Enables AI agents to reliably interact with legacy/complex websites by generating executable workflow code during development rather than relying on runtime DOM parsing. Reduces hallucination risk, cost, and latency by converting web interactions into structured API calls and debuggable scripts.

The spend and ROI command center for the modern engineering org 

TL;DR: Mentlio is the engineering intelligence platform for the AI-coding era. We help engineering organizations cut AI costs by up to 30% and finally see what ROI that spend is actually producing. All without ever collecting your prompts or source code.

Launch Video



Problem

Every engineering org is now an AI org. Token usage is growing exponentially, and so is the bill. The following questions have been largely unanswered:

* How can we cut our usage-based AI spend without bottlenecking usage or efficiency?
* What ROI are we getting for every dollar of AI spend?
* To what extent is AI-generated code creating quality debt?

Brian Armstrong recently laid out how Coinbase is reducing AI spend while token usage grows exponentially on X: better defaults, smarter routing, cache awareness,
mentlio.industry_sub_vertical: AI token and compute cost optimization for engineering teams

mentlio.ai_play: Uses custom ML models to analyze coding workflows, compress prompts, route requests to optimal models (cost/latency tradeoff), and attribute spend to individual engineers. Essentially an observability layer that turns raw AI spend into actionable cost signals and automated optimization.

miniswap.name: Miniswap
miniswap.description:
The Marketplace for Complex Hobbies

Miniswap a marketplace for complex hobbies, starting with Warhammer.

In hobbies as complex as Warhammer, finding what you want on general marketplaces is a huge pain. Filters don't work, free-form listings mean that products are regularly misidentified, and piles of counterfeit junk crowd search results. 

Miniswap saves hobbyists from this chaos with its catalogue of more than 20,000 unique miniatures. Sellers match their listings against Miniswap's catalogue giving buyers more information and structure as they shop.

The global market for tabletop games is estimated to be worth $20B in 2025 and Warhammer alone is projected to grow to $3B by 2030. By capturing the market in this untapped niche, Miniswap is strongly positioned to bringing greater transparency, simplicity, and connectivity into adjacent verticals.

Miniswap's founding team merges deep domain knowledge with elite programming expertise and years of experience in business consulting and startups. Co-founders Zak and Will met while studying together at Cambridge, bonded over their love of Warhammer and early modern history. They have been best friends ever since.

miniswap.ai_play: AI-powered product matching and catalogue standardization. Sellers' unstructured listings are automatically matched/normalized against the canonical Miniswap catalogue, eliminating misidentification, counterfeits, and search chaos. AI improves matching accuracy, reduces friction for both sides, and builds network effects through better discovery and trust.

minro.name: Minro
minro.one_liner: Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale
minro.description:
Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale

Minro helps companies stay close to their users as they scale.

Today, most startups have thousands of product events flowing through tools like PostHog, but still have no real understanding of who their users actually are, which users are quietly about to churn, or what outreach actually brings them back. Founders care deeply about their users, but staying close to them becomes operationally impossible very quickly.

Minro plugs directly into a company’s analytics stack and turns product activity into living customer intelligence. We enrich every user with context like their company, role, LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter, background, and likely use case, currently matching users to the correct online identity with ~80% accuracy starting from just name + email.

We then identify which users are most likely to churn based on behavioral patterns, persona similarity, and historical retention signals, and help founders proactively reach out before those users disappear. Minro drafts highly contextual founder-style outreach, tracks which conversations actually convert into retention, and continuously improves the system over time.

The result is a customer intelligence and retention layer that helps companies understand their users better, build stronger relationships, and reduce churn before it happens.
minro.industry_sub_vertical: SaaS churn prediction and retention automation for product-led growth companies
minro.what_they_sell: SaaS platform that integrates with analytics stacks (PostHog, etc.) to automatically identify at-risk users, enrich them with contextual identity/company/role data, predict churn likelihood, and autonomously draft and execute founder-style retention outreach at scale.
minro.ai_play: AI agents replace manual customer success workflows: (1) entity resolution (name+email → LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter identity with ~80% accuracy), (2) behavioral churn prediction (pattern matching + persona similarity + historical signals), (3) autonomous outreach generation (contextual, founder-voice messaging), (4) closed-loop learning (tracking conversion, iterating on messaging). Transforms raw product events into actionable customer intelligence and removes the manual work of identifying and reaching out to at-risk users.

mireye.one_liner: Infrastructure for Physical World AI Agents
mireye.description:
Infrastructure for Physical World AI Agents

AI agents are starting to act in the real world, but they can't reliably understand it. 

Geospatial data is complex, fragmented, and unstructured. Ask a model a specific question about a specific place and it guesses. Our API and MCP give agents cited answers about any location.

Our mission is to index every inch of the earth, and make it as queryable as the web.

One API for data, enrichment, tools and signals.

Every fact about a place has its own silo: land in GIS maps, power in utility portals, people in census tables, policy in county PDFs.

All built for humans, none for agents. Underneath, the data is fragmented across thousands of sources, unstructured and complex.

Even with clean data the problem isn't solved, because a decision takes more than retrieving facts.

What We Built: One API and MCP that connects your agent to the physical world

misprint.name: Misprint
misprint.one_liner: Misprint is building Robinhood for Pokemon cards
misprint.description:
Misprint is building Robinhood for Pokemon cards

Misprint is an all-in-one marketplace that solves the biggest pain point in the collectibles world: opaque pricing. Collectors, investors, and hobbyists currently rely on scattered data from auction houses, online forums, and reseller platforms, making it difficult to know the true value of their items. Misprint streamlines the process by combining accurate pricing analytics with a seamless buy/sell marketplace, making it easier than ever to understand and monetize collectible assets.

Existing marketplaces lack robust, real-time analytics because accurate valuations require deep expertise in both the collectibles domain and advanced pricing algorithms. Misprint’s unique blend of insider trading card knowledge and machine learning allows us to fill this gap.

Building these pricing models requires extensive data infrastructure, deep domain expertise, and cutting-edge ML. Recent surges in the trading card market show that collectors crave transparent valuations.

The global collectibles market is worth tens of billions of dollars. Eva has experienced the scale of this industry firsthand, generating $500k ARR within three months of taking her Pokemon card-selling side hustle full-time. With additional segments like sports cards, comics, and emerging collectible categories, the growth runway is immense.

Co-founders Eva and Jon have been best friends since Exeter, combining finance expertise, a passion for collectibles, and mathematical rigor. By merging Goldman Sachs-level financial analytics with top-tier mathematical talent, Misprint is uniquely positioned to become the go-to platform for fair, transparent pricing in the collectibles space.

misprint.ai_play: ML-driven pricing models that aggregate fragmented market data (auction houses, forums, resellers) to compute accurate, real-time valuations. AI replaces opaque manual pricing with algorithmic transparency, enabling collectors to make informed buy/sell decisions and reducing information asymmetry. Pricing models are the core defensibility — trained on domain-specific collectibles data and continuously refined with transaction data from the marketplace itself.

Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates.

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and more - and structure them into queryable, trustworthy context available to both humans and agents. No browser extension. No manual capture. Your thinking flows in automatically and compounds over time.

Today, Nessie is the memory layer that makes every AI interaction smarter - grounded in your actual reasoning, not the median. Your agents start with your accumulated thinking instead of a blank slate. Your decisions have provenance, traceable back to the conversation where the thinking happened.

Where we are going: the AI-native organization of the near future is a small team running thousands of agents. Those agents are powerful but amnesiac - they make decisions, form hypotheses, discover patterns, and forget everything between sessions. The organization's collective intelligence exists nowhere. There is no layer that integrates what the organization knows, what it has decided, and how its thinking has evolved. Nessie is that layer. Not another workspace. Not another wiki. The connective tissue that makes AI-native organizations possible.

Science has journals. Law has case law. Software has git. AI-native knowledge work has nothing. We are building the infrastructure for cumulative thinking in the AI era.

We are two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer F…

octapulse.description:
CV and robotics to automate quality inspection in fish farms

OctaPulse uses AI vision to automate hatchery QA for fish farms, starting with broodstock phenotyping and juvenile deformity inspection. We cut inspection time from about 5 minutes to under 30 seconds per fish, with more than 90 percent accuracy, so farms advance only high quality fish and waste less feed and labor. Our goal is to bring automation across the entire fish production lifecycle for the $300B aquaculture industry.

Aquaculture is the fastest growing food sector, and has already surpassed commercial fishing for production of seafood. Yet two of the most critical QA and QC steps in fish production are still done by hand: phenotyping and deformity inspection. These processes are slow, error prone, and despised by technicians but vital for the success of the farm, so much so that farms spend >$200K a year on trained technicians and geneticists to operate. We’ve built an AI vision platform for vertically integrated finfish farms that drops into existing workflows starting in the hatchery, uses off the shelf cameras, standardizes these QA steps, and creates a proprietary multi species dataset that becomes the brain for future autonomous aquafarms. Phenotyping is the start, but the platform is designed to be a drop in solution that can easily expand into feeding, health monitoring, and processing so we can solve production problems across the lifecycle.

 We signed a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, are deploying into 2 more farms early 2026, and trained models above 90 percent accuracy while cutting inspection time from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds. Each deployment adds labeled images to our dataset and improves cross species generalization.

We started trading prediction markets ourselves but couldn't backtest our strategies because the tooling for this emerging asset class didn't exist. The deeper we went, the more we saw that fragmentation between prediction markets and lack of clean data was going to be a big problem.

We launched a prosumer tier and grew to several thousand dollars in MRR within months. Now we're bringing it to institutions, building tooling with the rigor and depth serious desks demand. 

They're the fastest growing asset class in finance, and CFTC applications for new exchanges keep climbing. Each new venue makes the market bigger, the fragmentation worse, and the unified data layer more valuable. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

perseus-defense.name: Perseus Defense

America's Golden Dome for Drones

Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our self-guided missile platform is man-portable and multi-domain capable. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement over existing kinetic solutions.

The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. 

Traction: 
Jason and Steve used more than 100 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. In 8 short weeks following a strict 2-week design-build-test cycle, the team has gone through 4 major guided missile iterations with over 30 live-fire flight tests. They were invited to Ft. Hood to present thei…

Real-time sensor fusion (radar, optical, RF) detects and classifies drone threats autonomously. pgdog.name: PgDog

Scaling engine for PostgreSQL

PgDog is an application for sharding PostgreSQL. It understands SQL and can distribute queries automatically between databases. It's built for managed databases, like AWS RDS, and doesn't require any changes to application code or schema.

In addition to sharding, PgDog is a load balancer and pooler, so it can act as a replacement for PgBouncer, RDS Proxy, and other Postgres scaling products. It brings the simplicity and performance of HTTP load balancing to the database.

Built from the experience of sharding Postgres at Instacart during peak growth in 2020, PgDog is the answer to the old question: does Postgres scale? It does now.

playgent.name: Playgent
playgent.description:
Sandboxes for AI agents

When enterprise agents fail in production, the conditions that caused the failure are critical: user state, data, tool calls, and context. Without a way to recreate these conditions, teams can't fix what broke.

Playgent provides infrastructure to create high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Our environments come packaged as a single MCP url where tool calls are mocked, authentication is abstracted away, and test data can be initialized via natural language or JSON specifications.

Teams can use Playgent to reproduce production failures in safe, scoped environments that accurately reconstruct state. Finally, export runs as OTel traces from Playgent's environment to plug directly into your observability tools or RL pipelines.
playgent.industry_sub_vertical: AI agent sandbox & debugging infrastructure for production failure reproduction
playgent.what_they_sell: Infrastructure (SaaS + API) providing high-fidelity sandbox environments for AI agents. Environments abstract authentication, mock tool calls, initialize test data via natural language or JSON, and export runs as OTel traces for observability and RL training pipelines.
playgent.ai_play: Enables teams to reproduce production agent failures in safe, scoped environments by reconstructing exact user state, data, and context. Bridges the gap between production incidents and testable, debuggable scenarios—critical for agent reliability and continuous improvement via RL.

Wealth management firms have spent years digitizing their businesses.

They have CRMs, portfolio management systems, custodians, financial planning tools, document repositories, email, meeting notes, and increasingly, AI copilots.

But there’s still a fundamental problem:

Someone has to notice that work needs to happen.

Consider something simple.

A client normally keeps $100K in cash. One morning, that balance becomes $600K.

There may be no email.

No task.

No meeting.

No explicit instruction telling an advisor to investigate.

Someone has to notice the change, understand why it happened, determine whether action is required, gather the relevant context, decide what to do next, execute the work, and make sure it was done correctly.

AI copilots can make individual steps faster, but they still generally depend on a human to recognize the work, provide the context, and initiate the process.

That led us to a different question:

What if the work discovered itself?
